summary: Part 2 of Kabongo territory covers the Kitenge health zone (eastern Kabongo territory, Haut-Lomami, west of the Lualaba). No armed-group control or attacks were reported in Kitenge in 2025-2026; the 2026 Mai-Mai/Bakata Katanga resurgence was reported in Bukama, Malemba-Nkulu (e.g. Kyamona) and Mitwaba, east and south of this zone. ACP described Haut-Lomami as calm in September 2026. All locations are assessed as default state presence under the PNC, with low-to-medium confidence given proximity to Malemba-Nkulu and the lack of local reporting.

zones.description: Western and central Kitenge health zone (lon <= 25.85): Kenane/Budi, Kantonye, Kyabene/Kasenga, Mwine Ngoy, Fwila, Mpele, Kansele and surrounding villages
zones.evidence: No reports of armed-group presence or attacks in the Kitenge health zone in 2025-2026; local reporting concerns health (cholera, Jan 2026), not insecurity. Mai-Mai activity in 2026 was in Bukama and Malemba-Nkulu. State police/administration assumed.

zones.description: Eastern Kitenge health zone villages nearer Malemba-Nkulu (lon > 25.85: Lubonge, Kiloba, Kayambi, Kima, Kibamba, Kamaungu, Makena, Besaba, Muloe, Mashasha, Kasongo, Kabukomo)
zones.evidence: No reported armed-group activity, but these villages lie closest to Malemba-Nkulu territory where Mai-Mai/Bakata Katanga attacks resurged in 2026; state presence is thin and assumed.
